why: GeoRF-E_2015_10_fs2 crashed with Windows ACCESS_VIOLATION (returncode 3221225477 = 0xC0000005) 22.2s into the 663-job development run. The retry used identical inputs, settings and seeds and completed normally. This directory preserves the failed attempt's record so the occurrence is not reduced to a log line.

rows.train_group_filter: released: training rows restricted to groups present in the target month

failed_attempt.reason: worker process failed; see worker.log. An execution failure is not D19 no-split evidence and not a support exclusion (R23).

honest_statement: Zero unresolved failures after one native-crash retry. NOT 'no failures occurred'. The crash's cause remains undiagnosed; a successful retry does not establish that it was harmless or transient.
contract_basis: Retrying unchanged inputs after a native crash is execution repair, not a support exclusion (R23/D19) and not model or candidate selection.
